title: Equidistribution speed of iterated preimages for rational maps on the Riemann sphere
summary: The exponential equidistribution speed of iterated preimages for holomorphic endomorphisms on $\mathbb{P}^k$ was established by Drasin-Okuyama for $k=1$, and by Dinh-Sibony for arbitrary $k$. In this paper, we obtain a near-optimal equidistribution speed with order $O(nd^{-n})$ in dimension one for points that are not super-attracting periodic. Moreover, the equidistribution speed order $O(nd^{-n})$ holds not only for $C^2$ observables but also for Hölder continuous d.s.h. observables.
